title: festuca ovina var. amethystina
intro: Festuca ovina var. amethystina, commonly known as Amethyst Blue Fescue, is a variety of the Festuca ovina plant species, characterized by its vibrant blue-green foliage. This plant is valued for its potential health benefits, which include anti-inflammatory and antioxidant properties, and is used to support immune function and reduce stress. Therapeutically, Festuca ovina var. amethystina is believed to have calming and soothing effects, making it potentially useful in the treatment of anxiety and insomnia. The bioactive constituents of this plant include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and terpenoids, which contribute to its medicinal properties.
